game_title: String Glue – Ash Rim Trail Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – String Glue: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names. Each round, a new obsidian shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the spell_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 320 points of obsidian shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 320, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): String Glue
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'String Glue' (Week 2 slot 7), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Ash Rim Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spell_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 320 within 80 seconds.
